messages:
sam: Quick sync 1: customer asks for SLA-backed burst QoS classes inside Dedicated pools. They want a Gold burst (deterministic prewarm + guaranteed tail latency), Silver (best-effort prewarm + softer SLO), Bronze (no prewarm, cost-first).
nidhi: important: this touches commitments, billing, and placement. We need clear tradeoffs and defaults by contract tier.
mike: runtime note: Gold requires isolated warm hosts or node reservations. That changes multiplexing and will lower utilization. We can simulate with soft reservations first.
ops-oncall: ops requirements: separate health metrics per QoS class (prewarm_success_rate, tail_latency_by_qos), kill-switch per-tenant+qos, and an autoscale policy trace for each decision.
billing-bot: billing rules: each Gold reservation needs reservation_id and per-hour surcharge. Credits if SLA missed require measurable signal and invoice linkage.
sam: sketch of QoS policy model:
```
qos_profile:
  name: gold
  prewarm: deterministic
  max_burst_pct: 25
  surcharge_per_node_hour_usd: 12.00
  sla_tail_p95_ms: 120
  refund_formula: surcharge * (1 - success_rate)
```

nidhi: also propose a global tenant-level cap for combined Gold across pools to avoid cost/placement surprise. e.g., tenant_gold_global_cap_pct = 30.
mike: autoscale decision preference: when Gold eligible, policy should prefer prewarm_nodes then fallback to conservative measures. Decision trace must include why prewarm chosen and cost_estimate_usd.
ops-oncall: rollout plan: (1) spike to prototype QoS tagging + telemetry (1 week), (2) soft-reservations prototype + billing tags (2 weeks), (3) canary with 1 lighthouse enterprise for Gold reservations (4 weeks), (4) GA with contract add-on.
billing-bot: ensure invoice exports include reservation_id, qos_profile, and decision_trace_id. Also add a customer-visible line item that explains how refunds are calculated.
sam: launch criteria candidate: 1) Console shows QoS per-pool and per-reservation; 2) DECISION_TRACE emitted for prewarm actions; 3) billing export + refund calc tested; 4) ops runbook for rollback and throttles; 5) legal signoff on SLA wording.
nidhi: risk/mitigations: (a) utilization drop -> mitigate with surge pricing and optional overcommit pool, (b) abuse of Gold -> tenant-level caps + approval flows, (c) cross-region placement -> default to region-bound Gold unless customer requests cross-region.
ops-oncall: safety knobs: cooldown windows, prewarm_fail_counter -> auto-disable Gold for tenant for 1h on repeated failures, audit-only mode during canary.
mike: staffing: 2 runtime, 1 billing, 1 frontend, 1 ops for canary. estimate timeline: spike + prototype + canary = ~6 weeks.
sam: decision: run spike. Action items: - @mike create spike PR for tagging + decision trace; - @billing-bot draft invoice sample and surcharge calc; - @ops-oncall draft canary runbook and safety knobs; - @nidhi produce SLA wording draft.
product-bot: created tickets: #PL-4333 (spike: qos telemetry), #BILL-2450 (reservation billing + refunds), #FE-823 (Console qos view), #OPS-1533 (canary runbook).
sam: thanks all, will sync with sales to prepare contract language.
